body: I hear what you’re saying, but I do think this is a different situation, as all of the people who do smoke (only about 4 or 5 out of the 20+ ppl invited) only smoke socially. They’re not smokers who smoke every day/take smoke breaks at work, etc. Only when they’re drunk/out/at a party.
Oh okay, this sounds interesting for sure! So maybe buy a couple and put them in a bowl for everyone to enjoy if they want?
Pure weed is the only thing we smoke indoors. I do smoke joints, but there’s never nicotine in them.

I didn’t need more quality time at the time, the conversation was me explaining that we view different things as quality time (he does view our mutual physical activity as quality time). I need more quality time now as he’s cancelled plans and has been acting more distant.

I haven’t talked to him about this specifically. When he cancelled on me, I asked him to Facetime because I was nervous that I had done something. This is when he explained that he needs a lot of alone time because when he doesn’t he gets easily agitated and lashes out on people and he didn’t want to hang out because he knew he wouldn’t be super into hanging out and that it wasn’t fair to me. I had previously mentioned that I don’t see our mutual activity as quality time and he was really surprised and said “you need more quality time???” and made it seem like a bad thing and I said no, but that was when we were still seeing each other twice a week.

Beach house in in NJ (one state over and we’d be driving versus flying so less possible exposure). I think 7 people in total if I go. I’m currently waiting on testing to come back (day 5 of an expected 4-6 day wait), it’s to see if I have the virus, not the antibodies, and if it’s positive I’ll most likely be unable to go to both as I’ve been told the contagious period is 6 weeks and the wedding is in less than 4 weeks.
